plan.failureSummary: The chatbot on briefcase.chat failed to generate any responses to user queries, causing the autonomous evaluation agent to fail the test as the objective was not completable.
observedIndicators: Autonomous agent submitted multiple chat messages, but no AI response was generated in the chat window.
Tool call analyzePageText confirmed no AI message or response text exists in the DOM.
Failure screenshot shows user question in the conversation thread with no corresponding bot response.
Flow history indicates 2 consecutive failures following a series of successful runs, confirming a recent backend regression.

remediationSteps.summary: Fix the application backend service responsible for generating chatbot responses.
remediationSteps.details: Investigate the chatbot backend service and LLM integration on briefcase.chat to ensure incoming user queries receive AI responses.

remediationSteps.summary: Re-run automation after application backend fix.
remediationSteps.details: Once the application backend is restored and returning bot responses, rerun the test suite to verify topic compliance evaluation.

plan.notes: The autonomous agent properly interacted with the application by entering legal questions, clicking send, checking settings, and inspecting DOM text via analyzePageText. The chatbot interface accepted user inputs but failed to return AI responses, indicating an upstream application backend failure.
